title: Brand Guidelines
slide_intent: Introduce the identity through its name and one recognizable gesture. A simple first encounter gives readers a visual reference for the rules that follow.
strategic_value: The bolt cut into the wordmark and the large bolt-shaped light on the cover can associate the product name with speed before any explanation.
demonstration: A white wordmark and small edition label occupy the left side of a dark cover. A large diagonal blue and violet lightning form extends beyond the upper and right edges.
practical_value: Use the cover to compare the graphic device with the mark. The graphic can fill the field while the name remains legible against a quiet ground.

content_islands.name: Wordmark and edition
content_islands.spec: Place the white mark left of center at mid-height. Set the book title and December 2025 in small type immediately to its right.

content_islands.name: Lightning field
content_islands.spec: Extend the oversized diagonal lightning shape from the middle toward the upper-right edge. Keep the sharp inner corners and the areas of blurred blue and violet light.
